verdicts.observation: Line 149 of chronophage.lua says the kill is certain: 'you will sever their lifeline, slaying them instantly'. The target says '你将尝试切断目标的生命线，立刻杀死目标'. The added '尝试' (attempt) turns a certain kill into an uncertain one, and the next clause '立刻杀死目标' then contradicts it. The frozen source gives no save or chance check. Remove '尝试' so it reads like '你将切断目标的生命线，立刻杀死目标'.

Line 418 of doom.lua says the redirected damage goes to 'a random target affected by Prophecy of Treason', with no range limit. The target says '转移至周围随机受背叛预言影响的目标'. The added '周围' (nearby) is a range limit the source does not state. The frozen context does not include the implementation, so this extra limit is unsupported. Remove '周围' unless the code shows a range check. Minor: on line 415, 'whispers from the void' was translated as '回响' (echo), which loses 'whispers'.

Two problems in unlock-race_krog.lua, lines 24–26. (1) The concession on line 24, 'But while they are magic users Ziguranth took pity on them', was dropped. The target only says '然而，伊格兰斯同情…'. The point that the Ziguranth pitied the ogres even though they use magic, which goes against Ziguranth anti-magic, is lost. (2) The place name Zigur and the order Ziguranth are rendered inconsistently. Line 25, 'Zigur was finally able to create', is translated '伊格兰斯终于创造', using the Ziguranth name. Line 26, 'protectors of Zigur', is translated '伊格的坚实保护者'. So Zigur is rendered two different ways within this one entry, and the subject on line 25 changed from Zigur to the Ziguranth.
